coreIdea: PDA = FA + one stack (LIFO). Final-state and empty-stack acceptance are equivalent in power. DPDA is STRICTLY WEAKER than NPDA (unlike DFA=NFA).
mustRememberFormulas: DCFL ⊊ CFL — non-determinism genuinely adds power for PDA
Complement of a CFL is always recursive (decidable), even though NOT always CFL

patternRecognitionTable.seeThis: language description, asked to construct a PDA
PDA diagram given, asked what language it accepts or to trace a string
acceptance-mode equivalence or DPDA-vs-NPDA power claim

commonTrapsQuickList: DPDA ≠ NPDA in power (unlike DFA=NFA) — this is THE key PDA trap
Track full stack CONTENTS during tracing, not just stack height
Push/pop order: leftmost pushed symbol ends up on top of stack last
highYieldPyqLessons: Identify/trace-from-PDA (9/15) is the dominant skill — always track state AND full stack together, never shortcut.
Study this tightly paired with Context Free Language — PDA is CFL's machine model, same relationship as FA↔Regular.
